title: Finite-generation compact-open witness for the successor fibre-degree locus
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-qf-degree-successor-affine-compact, there exists an open U of S whose carrier is compact and equals the intersection of W with the degree-at-least-(r+1) locus.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Tag 07RZ, proof, second paragraph

proof.text: Write the closed degree-≤r locus on affine W as V(I), descend finite local freeness to a finitely generated subideal J, identify V(J)=V(I) by the universal criterion, and take the finite union of principal opens generated by J.
